description: The surah that declares that God bears witness that the false profession of faith by **The Hypocrites** is uttered only as a screen to hide their duplicity. It takes its name from its main topic, "the hypocrites" (munāfiqūn). The surah warns the believers about the treachery of the hypocrites and describes their behaviour in some detail. A specific occasion on which the hypocrites tried to stop anyone donating money to believers is described (verse 7 ff.) and God calls on the Muslims to compensate for this by giving more of their own funds to the needy (verse 9 ff.).

8.1: Or, 'the mighty will surely expel the weak from it.'

translations.1:
When the hypocrites come to _you_
 they say, 'We bear witness
 that _you_ are indeed the apostle of Allah.' Allah knows that _you_ are indeed His Apostle,
 and Allah bears witness that
  the hypocrites are indeed liars.
translations.2:
They make a shield of their oaths,
  and bar from the way of Allah.
 Evil indeed is what they used to do.
translations.3:
That is because they believed and then disbelieved,
 so their hearts were sealed. Hence they do not understand.
translations.4:
When you see them, their bodies impress you,
  and if they speak, _you_ listen to their speech.
 Yet they are like dry logs set reclining [against a wall]. They suppose every cry is directed against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them.
 May Allah assail them, where do they stray?!
translations.5:
When they are told, 'Come,
 that Allah's Apostle may plead for forgiveness for you,' they twist their heads,
 and _you_ see them turn away while they are disdainful.
translations.6:
It is the same for them
 whether _you_ plead for forgiveness for them,
  or do not plead for forgiveness for them:
 Allah will never forgive them.
 Indeed Allah does not guide the transgressing lot.
translations.7:
They are the ones who say, 'Do not spend
   on those who are with the Apostle of Allah
  until they scatter off.' Yet to Allah belong the treasuries of the heavens
  and the earth,
 but the hypocrites do not understand.
translations.8:
They say, 'When we return to the city,
 the mighty will surely expel the abased from it.'<{["F", 1]}> Yet all might belongs to Allah and His Apostle,
  and the faithful,
 but the hypocrites do not know.
translations.9:
O you who have faith! Do not let your possessions and children distract you
  from the remembrance of Allah,
 and whoever does that
  —it is they who are the losers.
translations.10:
Spend from what We have provided you
   before death comes to any of you,
  whereat he will say, 'My Lord,
   why did You not respite me for a short time
    so that I might have given charity
     and become one of the righteous!'
translations.11:
But Allah shall never respite a soul
  when its time has come,
 and Allah is well aware of what you do.
